Leadership Meet Our Founders Founder & CEO Krishnakumar Managing Director Sehyan Amal Share this page Twitter LinkedIn WhatsApp About Novox Edtech LLP Novox Edtech LLP is a leading IT training institute based in Calicut, Kerala,
                        dedicated to empowering students and professionals with industry-relevant skills. Founded with a
                        vision to bridge the gap between academic learning and real-world technology demands, we offer
                        comprehensive training programs in software development, digital marketing, and design. Our expert instructors bring years of hands-on industry experience to the
                        classroom, ensuring that every student receives practical, job-ready training. Whether you are a
                        fresh graduate looking to kickstart your career in tech or a working professional seeking to
                        upskill, our courses are designed to meet your needs. What Makes Us Different At Novox Edtech, we believe in learning by doing. Our curriculum is built around
                        real-world projects, case studies, and live coding sessions. Students work with the latest
                        technologies including the MERN Stack (MongoDB, Express.js, React, Node.js), Flutter for
                        cross-platform mobile development, Python for backend and data science, and modern UI/UX design
                        tools like Figma and Adobe XD. We offer both online and offline training modes, giving students the flexibility
                        to learn at their own pace from anywhere. Our small batch sizes ensure personalized attention,
                        and our dedicated placement support team helps graduates secure positions at top companies
                        across India. Our Training Programs Our course catalog covers a wide range of in-demand technology skills. From
                        full-stack web development with the MERN Stack to cross-platform mobile app development with
                        Flutter, from comprehensive Python programming to advanced digital marketing strategies, we have
                        a course for every aspiring tech professional. Each program includes hands-on projects, mentor
                        guidance, and an industry-recognized certification upon completion. We also offer specialized programs like the Alpha, Beta, and Zeta programs, each
                        tailored to different skill levels and career goals. Our AI development course introduces
                        students to machine learning, neural networks, and practical AI applications that are shaping
                        the future of technology. Located in the heart of Calicut, our campus features modern classrooms, high-speed internet, and
                        a collaborative co-working space where students can practice, network, and grow together. Join
                        the hundreds of successful graduates who have launched their tech careers with Novox Edtech. Placement Support and Career Growth At Novox Edtech, our commitment to students doesn't end at course completion. Our
                        dedicated placement team actively works with hiring partners across Kerala and beyond to connect
                        trained graduates with top employment opportunities. From resume building and interview
                        preparation to mock technical rounds and LinkedIn profile optimization, we provide end-to-end
                        career support to help every student land their dream IT job. Our growing network of industry partners spans software companies, digital
                        agencies, and technology startups — giving students access to a wide range of internship and
                        full-time job opportunities. We take pride in our strong placement record and continue to
                        strengthen our industry relationships to create more pathways for our students. Whether you are looking to work at a technology company, start your own digital venture, or
                        freelance as a software developer or digital marketer, Novox Edtech equips you with the tools,
                        knowledge, and confidence to succeed. Enroll today and take the first step toward a rewarding
                        career in technology. Know about classes We create unique digital media experiences. Professional Educators Get one-on-one help from our subject matter experts.
